spec: Test whether F041a's rank-2 monotone-in-nbp slope ladder survives Euler-product deflation at bad primes. Deflator = prod_{p|N} poly_p(1/p) from lmfdb.lfunc_lfunctions.bad_lfactors evaluated at s=1.

data.data_source_commit: lmfdb prometheus_sci snapshot at run time

verdict: SIGN_INVERSION_AND_RESHAPE  (auditor amended 2026-04-22 after reading numeric output): the deflator did not absorb the ladder's amplitude, but it FLIPPED the sign of the (nbp, slope) correlation from +0.65 (raw, mildly increasing) to -0.83 (deflated, strongly decreasing). The original F041a framing (monotone-increasing-in-nbp slope as evidence of arithmetic sensitivity) is substantially the bad-prime Euler-factor contribution at higher nbp. A NEW signal emerges in the Euler-deflated leading term: monotone-DECREASING-in-nbp slope, also strongly significant per stratum (z = 8-18). Pattern 30 disposition: PARTIAL leaning toward SHARED_VARIABLE on the original framing; the residual structure post-deflation is itself a candidate live-specimen.

null_protocol.note: Joint stratifier per null_protocol_v1.md Class 2 stricter variant.

method_notes: Deflator computed from bad_lfactors poly evaluated at T = 1/p.
Curve cohort: rank=2 EC, one per isogeny class (Cnumber='1').
Local Euler factor at multiplicative p: poly = [1, +/-1] -> L_p(1) = p/(p +/- 1).
Local Euler factor at additive p: poly = [1] -> L_p(1) = 1 (no contribution).
Deflated leading_term replaces bad-prime contribution with 1; retains good-prime structure + RMT factor.
verdict_initial_amplitude_test: PERSIST  (amplitude-ratio < 0.20: deflator did not collapse ladder amplitude)
verdict_caveats: PATTERN-19 FLAG: raw per-stratum slopes (~0.25 across nbp 1-5, 0.32 at nbp=6) are roughly 5x smaller than F041a's recorded values (1.21..2.52). Possible causes: (a) stratified random sample (5K/nbp via md5(label) ranking) differs from F041a's ~222K joined cohort; (b) F041a's slope normalization may differ (e.g., per-decade-then-pool vs single OLS over full conductor range); (c) F041a's recorded numbers may need re-audit. This audit should be re-run on F041a's exact reproduced cohort before any tensor mutation.
SAMPLE: 19,414 rank-2 primary EC (Cnumber=1), stratified cap 5000/nbp, joined with lfunc_lfunctions on origin = EllipticCurve/Q/<conductor>/<iso_letter>.
Null is correct per null_protocol_v1.md Class 2 stricter variant (joint (nbp, conductor_decade)); per-stratum z>=8 in BOTH raw and deflated, so the slope structure is real in both directions.
Sign-inversion is the methodological finding: a coarse 'amplitude absorbed?' test misses sign flips. Pattern 30 PARTIAL audits should include a sign-preservation check, not just a magnitude check.
